title: Midcareer engineering sync — prep scratch
content:
Context / TL;DR:
- 1:1 with Alejandro (senior SWE, owning KV cache + batching infra) — goal: unblock perf regression, align on career trajectory (next step: staff/tech-lead discussion), and sync on mentoring plan.
- Recent: PR 1289 landed but introduced ~12% latency regression on short-context gen in internal perf tests. He already rolled back in canary but wants a plan to reintroduce with fixes.
- Wants clearer roadmap for leadership responsibilities and impact metrics for promotion packet (missing cross-team metrics and release ownership examples).

Meeting goals (my priorities):
1) Surface what he knows about the regression root cause and confirm next steps to isolate/fix.
2) Discuss concrete examples for promotion packet and set 90-day milestones.
3) Decide pairing / resources for rework and testing (who helps, timeline, infra quota).
4) Quick check on wellbeing / workload — ensure no burnout.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 0:00–2:00 quick personal check-in (energy, blockers unrelated to work)
- 2:00–10:00 regression summary (he presents: what changed, signal, repro steps, triage done)
- 10:00–18:00 technical remediation options and trade-offs (rollback vs iterative fix, perf/perf-sla risks)
- 18:00–24:00 career calibration (examples for promotion, leadership scope)
- 24:00–28:00 resources / pairing / test plan / owner assignments
- 28:00–30:00 quick commitments + recap + any quick wins

Notes / prompts for Alejandro (things to ask):
- Can you show the minimal repro? Which model/seq-len causes the spike? (ask for command line + perf numbers)
- Which kernel/quant path touched this PR? Are there specific inputs that amplify regression?
- Who on infra/ops saw the load change? Any correlation with autoscaler?
- If we reintroduce a canary patch, what are the exact metrics we must track? (p95/p99 latency, token throughput, tail-errors)
- For promotion packet: list 3 cross-team impacts in last 12 months (prod incident, feature rolled out, performance improvement with measurable ROI). Can we draft language today for 2 of them?
- Mentorship: who are 1–2 direct mentees, and one practical example of mentorship impact (PR reviews, onboarding docs, demos).

Signals I want to hear (deciding if he’s ready for staff):
- Ownership beyond code: ran a cross-functional rollout, influenced product trade-offs, shipped measurable performance wins that changed SLOs or cost.
- Clear examples of coaching and mentorship with outcomes (junior engineers promoted, fewer handoffs).
- Strategy thinking: proposing experiments with cost/latency tradeoffs and shipping an A/B rollout.

Immediate unblock checklist (for discussion / quick decisions):
- [ ] Alejandro to paste minimal repro command + perf numbers to PR thread by EOD (owner: Alejandro, due: 2027-06-21)
- [ ] I will book 2h pairing with infra team (owner: Sahana, due: 2027-06-22)
- [ ] Run a controlled canary on dedicated pool for short-context only (owner: infra/SRE, assigned: Priya, due: 2027-06-23)
- [ ] Prepare a short 1-page promotion evidence draft (owner: Alejandro + Sahana, due: 2027-07-05)

Possible remediation paths (talk through pros/cons):
- Full revert (low risk, loses improvement that PR intended)
- Targeted patch to reduce tail latency (requires kernel-level tweak, longer test window)
- Dynamic routing by seq-length (serve short context on fallback optimized path)
- Feature-flagged rollout with telemetries for p95/p99 and cost-per-token

Career conversation quick structure (10m):
- Where Alejandro wants to be in 12–18 months (ask explicitly).
- What leadership examples he can own next (lead a cross-team perf sprint, own an on-call runbook, be the point for Dedicated perf go-live).
- Agree 3 concrete deliverables for promotion packet: 1) cross-team rollout case study, 2) measurable performance win, 3) mentorship evidence + org influence note.

Follow-ups / action items (after meeting):
- Alejandro: post repro + perf artifacts to PR 1289 and JIRA INF-3421 (due 2027-06-21).
- Sahana: schedule pairing block with Priya + infra (2027-06-22).
- Priya: create canary job + dashboards for short-context path (deadline 2027-06-23).
- Alejandro + Sahana: first draft of promotion evidence (2027-07-05).
- Sahana: raise a quick sync with product about acceptance criteria for KV-cache rollout (2027-06-24).

Quick wins to offer in meeting (to build momentum):
- I can unblock a dedicated GPU slot for a focused 24h perf run (I will free up a slot if Priya signs off).
- Offer to co-author the promo draft and review language for cross-team impact.
- Suggest temporary opt-out routing for customers showing regressions to reduce blast radius.

Tone notes to self: keep it collaborative, don’t put him on defensive — focus on facts and measurable outcomes. Ask questions that surface trade-offs, avoid immediate judgement on PR.

Risks / escalations to note:
- If repro suggests platform-level change, this may need release window alignment with Dedicated customers. Raise early.
- If we miss canary window, customers could see tail regressions -> notify CS early.

Prep checklist for meeting (my pre-meeting actions):
- [ ] skim PR 1289 and the rollback notes (done: skimmed, still need deeper read)
- [ ] pull last 7 days of perf dashboards for short-context queries
- [ ] draft outline for promotion evidence with suggested bullets

Last-minute items to bring up if time:
- Interest in leading a perf sprint at next all-hands (visibility + cross-team credit)
- Potential mentoring pairings (match Alejandro with 2 junior folks)

Notes after the meeting (placeholder):
- Summary + decisions we agreed on + next sync cadence (add timestamps after meeting).
